newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel May tourist traffic rises.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel May tourist traffic rises.

text.p: Anglo-French Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel said on Thursday the number of vehicles using its Le Shuttle Tourist service in May rose 9.0 percent compared with April and grew 1.0 percent versus the year-ago month.
Le Shuttle Tourist carried 156,559 vehicles (including cars and motorcycles) and 5,787 buses in May, Eurotunnel said in a statement released here.
The company said Eurostar traffic was "very similar" to April's figures this year, but posted a 15 percent increase to 491,457 passengers versus May 1996.
Rail freight trains carried a record 267,060 tonnes in May, up from 208,602 a year earlier.
By May 31, some 1,289 non-paying trucks had been transported by Le Shuttle Freight.
The service was restarted on a test basis on May 28 after having been closed since a fire last November.
However, on Thursday, Eurotunnel said it suspended the transport of trucks through the tunnel after a problem with the overhead electrical power supply.
Full commercial service was due to restart from mid-June, the company said.
